1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is not a living tissue and said second component is not a living tissue.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a __humeral surface component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ is spherically or elliptically shaped.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said __humeral surface component__.

12. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface __on said humeral surface component__ for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said __humeral surface component__ has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Cancelled)

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said __humeral surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw.

27. (Currently Amended) __An implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint__ comprising __an implant providing__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant.

28. (Currently Amended) The __implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) __A humeral bone implant__ comprising a modular implant with a __humeral surface component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be anchored__ in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of __a__ humerus bone.

30. (Currently Amended) The __humeral bone implant__ of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently Amended) The __humeral bone implant__ of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
